trans-unit.source: Each company keeps the same color on every risk-level page and in every sort order — and the same color it uses in the Audits by Sub-Division detail view. The leading company for this risk level is outlined rather than recolored, so its color still identifies it correctly.

Das führende Unternehmen dieser Risikostufe wird umrandet statt umgefärbt, sodass es weiterhin eindeutig an seiner Farbe erkennbar ist.
